data.name: NoRecords
data.value: No records match the current filter.

data.name: Attestation
data.value: I attest that this record is accurate and complete to the best of my knowledge.

data.name: RestrictedNotice
data.value: You do not have permission to view the restricted sections of this record.

data.name: DuplicateWarning
data.value: A record of this type already exists for this call. Review it before continuing, or state why a second record is needed.

data.name: ActivateIntro
data.value: Records replaces the Logs module for this department. After activation, existing Logs remain readable in the Logs module but can no longer be created, edited or deleted. This cannot be undone once a record has been finalized.

data.name: LockViewGroupRecordsToGroup
data.value: Limit record visibility to the viewer's own group

data.name: ActivationAcknowledge
data.value: I understand that this cannot be reversed once a record is finalized, and that retention configuration is this department's responsibility.

data.name: NotActivatedNotice
data.value: Records is enabled for this department but has not been activated yet. A department administrator must activate it before records can be created.

data.name: DefaultLifecyclePreset
data.value: Default lifecycle preset for department definitions

data.name: IncludeYear
data.value: Include the year in record numbers

data.name: RetentionIntro
data.value: Shipped defaults: 7 years for standard records; permanent for Coroner and other restricted classes. Retention configuration is this department's responsibility under its own jurisdiction's rules. Changes apply prospectively and are audited.

data.name: RestrictedOverrideConfirm
data.value: This is a restricted class. Setting a period enables automatic purge of these records. Confirm to apply.

data.name: GroupVisibilityNote
data.value: Group scoping also requires the "See other groups' Records" permission to be locked to group. Authors, reviewers, named participants, responding unit crews and department administrators always see a record.

data.name: ConcurrencyError
data.value: This record was changed by someone else since you opened it. Reload and apply your changes again.

data.name: AmendmentOpen
data.value: An amendment is in progress. The last finalized revision remains authoritative until the amendment is finalized.

data.name: ExportLimitNotice
data.value: Exports include at most {0} rows; narrow the filter to export more.

data.name: SearchUnavailable
data.value: Search is unavailable right now; the list below is filtered without the search text.

data.name: SearchTruncated
data.value: Only the closest matches are shown; narrow the search to see more.

data.name: NarrativeSearchOn
data.value: Narrative text is included in search.

data.name: NarrativeSearchOff
data.value: Narrative text is not indexed for this department; search covers record numbers, summaries and other safe fields.

data.name: SearchIndexNote
data.value: The worker rebuilds the search index automatically whenever the department's protection policy or catalog version changes. Narrative search is withdrawn when Advanced Data Protection is enrolled.

data.name: PrintLayoutIntro
data.value: How the letterhead renders on record prints. Identity and logo come from the Department Profile; the record content itself always prints from the pinned revision.

data.name: PrintDateTimeFormatHelp
data.value: Optional .NET format string, for example yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm; leave empty for the department default.

data.name: NoLogoNotice
data.value: No logo has been uploaded yet; prints show the department name only.

data.name: ExportSearchUnavailable
data.value: Search is unavailable right now, so the search hits could not be exported. Clear the search to export the filtered list instead.

data.name: ReassignNote
data.value: Transfers ownership of this unfinished Record to another member. The author and the creation history do not change, and the transfer is audited.

data.name: GroupScopePreviewIntro
data.value: What group scoping would hide, before you confirm it. Members always keep the Records they authored, own, review, participate in or respond to with their unit, and department administrators see everything.

data.name: GroupScopeHiddenFromUngrouped
data.value: Records hidden from members of no group

data.name: GroupScopeUnanchored
data.value: Records with no group anchor (stay department-wide)

data.name: GroupScopeLegacyRows
data.value: Legacy log rows with no group (stay department-wide)

data.name: GroupScopeConfirm
data.value: I understand what group scoping hides and want to turn it on.

data.name: GroupScopeConfirmRequired
data.value: Group scoping was not turned on: confirm the impact preview first. The other settings were saved.

data.name: AccountabilityIntro
data.value: Who owes a report: open Records, overdue reviews and returned Records by person, station or unit, with time to finalize over the window. Reminders go to the owner, at most once a day per Record.

data.name: IncidentReportsIntro
data.value: One authoritative incident report per call. Reports start from the dispatched call, carry the source of every prefilled value, and are validated against the pinned NERIS contract before they are attested and submitted.

data.name: NoActiveCalls
data.value: No active calls; open a closed call from Dispatch to start its report.

data.name: IncidentReportStarted
data.value: Incident report started from the call.

data.name: ExistingReportForCall
data.value: This call already has an incident report.

data.name: NoSubmissions
data.value: This revision has not been submitted.

data.name: ValidationBlocked
data.value: Fix the errors below before finalizing.

data.name: SubmissionDisabledNotice
data.value: NERIS submission is not enabled for this department. Finalized reports stay local until an administrator configures the NERIS profile.

data.name: SystemDisabledNotice
data.value: NERIS submission is switched off system-wide; reports can be authored and finalized but not delivered.

data.name: ProfileNotConfigured
data.value: The NERIS profile is not configured.

data.name: RejectedNotice
data.value: NERIS rejected this report. Correct the fields and resubmit; a new revision and a new idempotency key are created.

data.name: SubmittedNotice
data.value: This report is with NERIS. Editing waits until the destination answers.

data.name: ProvenanceIntro
data.value: Where each prefilled value came from. Corrections keep the original beside the corrected value.

data.name: NerisSettingsIntro
data.value: The department's NERIS identity, credential and environment, plus the crosswalk from local call types to NERIS incident types. Credentials are stored encrypted per department and are never shown again.

data.name: CredentialStored
data.value: A credential is stored. Leave the fields blank to keep it.

data.name: AutoSubmitOnFinalize
data.value: Submit automatically when a report is finalized

data.name: NerisEnabled
data.value: Enable NERIS submission for this department

data.name: CrosswalkIntro
data.value: Map each dispatch call type to the NERIS incident type it prefills. Unmapped types leave the incident type for the author to choose.

data.name: AnalysisAwaitingIncident
data.value: This analysis is finalized and will be filed as soon as the incident itself reaches NERIS.

data.name: AwaitingReviewHint
data.value: Records submitted for review and not yet approved

data.name: CaptureReason
data.value: Why this evidence is being captured

data.name: CrosswalkCoverageIntro
data.value: Every local call type that has no NERIS code will need classifying by hand on the night.

data.name: DashboardDegraded
data.value: Some counts could not be produced:

data.name: DisclosureIntro
data.value: A records request carries a statutory clock, so it is tracked here rather than answered ad hoc.

data.name: DisclosureOverdueNotice
data.value: This request is past its statutory due date.

data.name: DisclosureReasonRequired
data.value: A reason is required to close a records request.

data.name: DisclosureReleased
data.value: The production was released to the requester.

data.name: EvidenceIntro
data.value: Each artifact is a bounded snapshot taken once, checksummed and never changed; a correction is a new capture.

data.name: EvidenceReadinessPacket
data.value: Readiness at the time of the call

data.name: EvidenceReasonRequired
data.value: A reason is required to capture evidence into an official record.

data.name: EvidenceUnavailable
data.value: That evidence source had nothing to capture for this record.

data.name: FinalizeAnalysisIntro
data.value: Finalizing writes the immutable revision. Filing waits for the incident's NERIS id if it does not have one yet.

data.name: IncidentAnalysisIntro
data.value: The fire and hazmat investigation is filed separately from the incident, once the destination already holds it.

data.name: NoEvidenceCaptured
data.value: No evidence has been captured against this report.

data.name: NoSectionsYet
data.value: No conditional sections apply until an incident type is chosen.

data.name: ProduceIntro
data.value: A production is a new immutable artifact; a later amendment cannot change what was released.

data.name: ProductionIntact
data.value: The production checksum still matches; it has not been altered.

data.name: ProductionTampered
data.value: The production checksum does not match what was stored.

data.name: RecordsNotActivated
data.value: Records is not activated for this department yet.

data.name: RejectedHint
data.value: Rejected by the destination and not yet corrected

data.name: RequesterIdentityWithheld
data.value: Who asked is restricted and is not shown here.

data.name: ResourcesNotSubmitted
data.value: kept on the department record only, never sent to NERIS

data.name: RestrictedFieldsHidden
data.value: Some fields are restricted and are not shown to you.

data.name: ScopeFrozen
data.value: The scope is frozen because something has already been produced against it.

data.name: ScopePreviewTruncated
data.value: More records match than are listed here.

data.name: SectionNoLongerApplies
data.value: This section no longer applies to the selected incident types.

data.name: StatutoryDueHint
data.value: Left blank, the department's statutory clock sets it.

data.name: CredentialRequiredForGrantTypeChange
data.value: A new credential is required when the NERIS grant type changes.
